device_categories.name: Pantallas y sistemas multimedia de automóvil

universal_tools.name: Android SDK Platform-Tools (ADB/Fastboot)
capabilities: read properties exposed by an authorized device
read Fastboot variables exposed by the device
universal_tools.notes: Official host tools are not automatically executable inside an Android app. This catalog entry does not authorize unlocking or writing partitions.

universal_tools.name: USB device inspector
capabilities: enumerate USB descriptors after Android permission
show VID/PID/interface descriptors and connection state
universal_tools.notes: USB descriptors may suggest vendor/protocol but do not necessarily identify the exact model or board revision.

universal_tools.name: Adaptador externo de medición USB (hardware del usuario)
capabilities: consume timestamped calibrated input voltage/current and charger-state samples, if adapter supports them
universal_tools.notes: USB cable/OTG alone is not a multimeter. No pin-level readings or short localization are claimed without a compatible validated meter.

universal_tools.name: Qualcomm EDL service references
capabilities: identify supported recovery interface where host permissions allow
universal_tools.notes: EDL, programmers and service authorization are model/OEM-specific. No auth-bypass method or firmware payload included.

universal_tools.name: MediaTek service-tool references
capabilities: identify supported USB interface where possible
universal_tools.notes: Model and security configuration determine support. No SLA/DAA bypass, auth circumvention, or firmware payload included.

universal_tools.name: Official manufacturer firmware/support links
capabilities: show official support page matched to user-confirmed exact model, variant and region
universal_tools.notes: No ROM/firmware in the repo. Download is user-initiated and must show provenance, compatibility, size and published integrity checks; never auto-flash.
